scripts/spot_client/spot_client.py

Jetson process entry point. Starts a GStreamer publisher thread and an MQTT control thread.

class SpotClient(broker_address, image_source)

Robot-side MQTT subscriber and control-thread owner.

Parameters:

  • broker_address (str) – Public IPv4 of the Mosquitto / MediaMTX VM.

  • image_source (str) – "ZED" or "SPOT".

sub_topic: str = "oculus/inputs"
inputs: list[float]

Latest HMD + thumbstick sample, mutated by on_message().

flag_connected: int

1 while the 4G probe succeeds; otherwise reconnect() runs instead of SpotInterface.set_controls().

on_connect(client, userdata, flags, rc)

Subscribe to oculus/inputs after CONNACK.

on_message(client, userdata, msg)

json.loads the payload into inputs.

reconnect()

sudo systemctl restart simcom_wwan@wwan0.service then sleep 30 s.

control_loop()

Forever:

  1. get_setpoints(inputs[0:3]) — HMD reference.

  2. get_body_orientation() — integrated robot pitch/yaw.

  3. get_hmd_controls + get_touch_controls(inputs[3:6]).

  4. set_controls(hmd + touch) if the uplink is up.

KeyboardInterrupt sits the robot and closes MQTT.

stream_loop_zed(broker_address, image_source)

Open ZEDInterface and a cv2.VideoWriter whose pipeline is the NVIDIA hardware encoder at 3 Mbit/s, GRAY8 1280×240 @ 60. Writes every get_image() frame to MediaMTX over TCP.

stream_loop_spot(broker_address, spot)

Same idea using the onboard cameras via SpotInterface.get_image(), 960×640 @ 30, 0.6 Mbit/s.

main(broker_address, image_source)

Dispatch on image_source and start both threads.

CLI

python spot_client.py [ip_address] [image_source]

Defaults: 34.16.188.15, ZED.
